A '''degree-six revolt''' was a term used to describe uprisings by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=general|Testing Grounds|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> Around the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Dromund Kaas rebellion|rebellion]] on the Empire's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], was classified as a degree-six revolt by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Drowl]].<ref name="TOR" />
